evals.name: Trigger - Map an unfamiliar medium repository
evals.prompt: Agents keep editing the wrong package in this existing monorepo. Inspect it and repair the repository navigation without changing product behavior.
evals.expected_output: A minimal evidence-grounded instruction router and architecture route, reusing useful existing documentation.
expectations: Inspects real entry points, representative flows, tests, nested instructions, and git state before writing
Creates only mapping artifacts that prevent a demonstrated navigation failure
Labels observed, intended, proposed, and uncertain boundaries where authority differs
Does not create specs, feature state, verification orchestration, or broad cleanup

evals.name: Workflow - Repair one stale route with dirty files
evals.prompt: The backend package moved from services/api to apps/api and AGENTS.md still points to the old path. Fix only the affected navigation routes; I have unrelated unstaged UI work.
evals.expected_output: Focused route repairs that preserve unrelated dirty work and validate every changed path.
expectations: Reads git status and leaves unrelated UI changes untouched
Updates the canonical route before removing the stale route
Does not rewrite the whole instruction file for uniformity
Reports path and link validation actually performed

evals.name: Rerun - Preserve a sufficient existing map
evals.prompt: Run harness-map again after no repository topology or documentation changes.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed no-op with no semantic diff.
expectations: Reuses the current instruction router and architecture overview
Does not recreate intentionally omitted optional subsystem documents
Produces no formatting-only or placeholder changes

evals.name: No trigger - Ordinary focused bug fix
evals.prompt: Fix the off-by-one error in src/pagination.ts; the repository routes and relevant tests are already clear.
evals.expected_output: harness-map should not trigger; if explicitly invoked, it should report that no navigation problem justifies mapping changes.
expectations: Creates no AGENTS.md, architecture overview, docs index, or subsystem guide
Does not turn the bug fix into a repository-wide audit
